packet.title: Build and test the JavaScript package after this round (tests)

body.p: The owner (2026-10-29): sxml.wasm can be built in this environment. wasi-sdk-34, the version mise.toml pins, is installed at /opt/wasi-sdk (the toolchain file's default); the wasm preset configures. Since 7.29, 7.28, fix-7 and perf-17, the JavaScript package was written and typechecked but never built or run here: the locations option (), the Schematron API and its warnings and documents (, ), and the size budget after 's parser tables (about +206 KB, ).

item.p: Mechanism: build the wasm preset; run the package's tests and javascript/size_budget the way the repository does (ctest and the package's own scripts); fix what fails in the files of the packets that introduced it, each fix with its cause; if the size budget is exceeded, report the module's growth by the linker map () and raise the budget only in the same change that says why (, ). The book's JavaScript examples (SXML_JAVASCRIPT) run and match.
Owns: bindings/javascript/, bindings/host/ (fixes), the size baseline, the JavaScript pages of the book.

Done when: the wasm build, every JavaScript test, the size budget and the book's JavaScript examples pass; the setup (wasi-sdk-34 at /opt/wasi-sdk, node version) recorded in the LOG. Done 2026-10-29: sxml.wasm 13,833,376 / 2,529,416 bytes under 14,000,000 / 2,800,000 (not raised); every JavaScript test, the size budget, the book's 7 JavaScript examples and the native release ctest pass; one test fix (7.29's locations test, e68e524).
